cta.heading: Sun* Kudos
cta.body: Recognising and thanking colleagues — held for the first time, and open to every Sunner. Running from November 2025, it invites Sun* people to share words of recognition and thanks for their colleagues on the system announced by the organising committee. This will be material the Heads Council draws on when selecting the award recipients.
